items.headline: Gotabaya says he can't recall in Lalith-Kugan case
items.summary: Testifying by video link to the Jaffna Magistrate's Court, former President Gotabaya Rajapaksa repeatedly said he could not remember events from his time as Defence Secretary. His further evidence was put off to February 12.

items.headline: Finance Ministry welcomes S&P upgrade
items.summary: The Finance Ministry hailed S&P's move to raise Sri Lanka from CCC+ to B- with a stable outlook, noting it follows a similar Fitch upgrade in September.

items.headline: Two-year rebuild plan for Ditwah-hit transport
items.summary: The Transport Minister told Parliament a Rs. 125 billion, two-year programme to rebuild roads and bridges damaged by Cyclone Ditwah is under way. Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa said the disaster response has fallen short and urged a new disaster-management mechanism.

items.headline: Three held with 47,000 cigarettes at BIA
items.summary: Customs stopped three young Sri Lankan travellers at Katunayake airport carrying about 47,000 foreign cigarettes worth roughly Rs. 7 million hidden in their luggage.

items.headline: FIFA and AFP hit by cyberattacks
items.summary: FIFA said hackers posing as staff accessed a small amount of personal and business data, while news agency AFP took its client content platform offline after an overnight attack.

items.headline: Namal: only 3% of rural development funds spent
items.summary: SLPP MP Namal Rajapaksa told Parliament roughly Rs. 1 billion of the Rs. 35 billion rural development allocation has been used, and urged the government to stop blaming past administrations.

items.headline: Namal alleges staff signed in, then attended President's rally
items.summary: Showing an attendance sheet and selfies, Namal Rajapaksa claimed public servants marked duty before attending a presidential meeting, and asked why the rules used against a remanded trade unionist were not applied to them.

items.headline: First female honorary consul in Türkiye
items.summary: Entrepreneur Elif Yücelik has been appointed Sri Lanka's honorary consul in Erzurum, covering Eastern Anatolia for three years, the first woman in the role in Türkiye.

items.headline: Recycling facility opens in Kattankudy
items.summary: A material recovery facility to sort household plastic, polythene and glass has opened at the Kattankudy Urban Council under the Clean Sri Lanka programme.

items.headline: Rohit Sharma back as Mumbai Indians captain
items.summary: Mumbai Indians reappointed Rohit Sharma as captain for IPL 2027, after Hardik Pandya moved to Punjab Kings in a trade.
